units.title: Analysis discipline — raw first, then the read

skim.know_text: This is our ABAB device. And this agent called it ABAB
skim.skim_impression: The fans look of acceptable quality and FFT analysis is clearish, not particularly clear but enough to answer stacking order.

final.reanalysis: Most analysis in this run is shaky at best. Reported mass numbers are not good, masses depend on FFT windows, density never properly calibrated, tones predicted as not being able to be resolved for unclear reasons.
final.overall_read: These agents continually waste effort by not taking good enough measurements. The FFTs are heavily blurred and compound mass. The fan done by this agent is on the better side compared to others. It therefore was able to correctly infer density tracking. But such coarseness heavily effects the extracted masses. So it got to the 'right' answer, but the numbers it reports are not great.
final.biggest_right: It's adjudication of spurious tones in the Landau fan was reasonable.
final.biggest_wrong: Asserting that it could not resolve an ABCA tone for the hole side scan because of its misread of the CNP
